steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In January 2023, Equity Mates used the sports drink category to show Gatorade, owned by PepsiCo, led the market, and Coca-Cola’s $5.6 billion Bodyarmor deal underscored how strong and popular PepsiCo’s product was in that segment.

episode.title: Have we reached peak soft drink? - Coca-Cola | Summer Series

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In May 2024, Equity Mates reported PepsiCo said inflation was still present throughout its pipeline, pointing to ongoing cost pressures that could influence margins and profitability.

episode.title: Snapchat and Spotify are back, Bonza isn't & Pimp my Portfolio returns

views.text: In March 2022, Equity Mates said food and consumer staples were dominated by a few giants including PepsiCo, highlighting industry consolidation that suggested entrenched competitive positions.

episode.title: Rate rises, growth stocks & Ren's monopoly thesis

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In March 2022, Equity Mates noted PepsiCo used Microsoft’s autonomous systems to simulate manufacturing and improve product consistency, indicating continued investment in operations and technology.

episode.title: Compair the pair - CEOs go head to head | Quartr Reporting Season

views.text: In January 2022, Equity Mates explained many major brands, including PepsiCo, partnered with Beyond Meat to trial plant-based products, framing these partnerships as experimentation to explore growth areas.

episode.title: Is this the taste of the future of food? - Beyond Meat | Summer Series

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In January 2025, a guest on Equity Mates contrasted expensive US staples with PepsiCo trading at about 17 times earnings, noting its portfolio that included Lay’s and beverages as context for the multiple.

episode.title: Expert: Andrew Brown - 14 Bold Predictions for 2025
